layer_classification.note: enforce() implements the BROADER FULL_SPEC §7.1 policy (node-gate subset ∪ acceptance bands ∪ §6.12 AIS ∪ class-veto) — a SEPARATE policy layer distinct from the frozen LAB Gamma engine (evaluate_decision).
